note: ISC shuttles and fighters. The shared documentation, and the craft any faction
may field, are in common.json.
SOURCE: Master Fighter Chart, Captain's Module G3 pages 139-140, section (R13.0)
INTER-STELLAR CONCORDIUM FIGHTERS. It is in data/rules/Master_Annex_File.pdf as Annex #4,
PDF pages 140-141 — NOT a missing book. pdftotext scrambles that table badly (type names
land in one column and their numbers in another), so every figure below was read off a
rendered page rather than the text layer.
COLUMN MAPPING, calibrated against the Gorn G-18 which was already entered:
chart Dmg  -> hull        chart Spd -> speed
chart BPV  -> bpv         chart Year -> year
The chart's Size, DFR, Prod and Ref columns have no home in this schema and are dropped.
CRIPPLED is NOT in the chart. It is J1.33: a shuttle is crippled when damage 'equals or
exceeds 2/3 of their destruction point', rounding fractions UP — the rule gives its own
example, destroyed by eight means crippled by six. So crippled = ceil(hull * 2/3), which
reproduces all 72 entries already in this folder without a single mismatch. Nothing here
is a guess at that number.
ONLY THE NINE BASE TYPES ARE ENTERED. The chart pairs each with an 'M' variant at double
speed and a higher price (AFM, EFM, SFM, TFM, FSFM, FDFM, FEFM, FTFM, FTKM), and lists
bombers and heavy fighters besides (BMR, HBMR, HF, HFF, FKF, FEK). None is entered,
because none is referenced by the fighter line below. They are not missing data so much
as data nobody has asked for yet.
_decisionsWorthKnowing: EW PODS ARE 'fixedEwPods', NOT 'ewPods', on the EF and the FEF — reasoned from the rules
below and CONFIRMED by the owner 2026-10-23. J4.962 says an EWP
'replaces one drone carried by the fighter' — those are the rail-mounted ones this schema
calls ewPods. J4.964 is the one that speaks of pods 'built-in'. The FEF settles it: its
Plasma-D/K column is a dash, so it carries no rails at all, and pods it has no rails for
must be built in. The EF is recorded the same way, and so is the Gorn G-18E, which has the
same shape on the same chart.
TWOSEATER on both EW fighters is J4.43 — 'two seats, which every EW fighter has'. Taken
from the rule, not inferred from the chart, which does not carry it.
SCATTERPACKSIZE IS ZERO EVERYWHERE HERE. FD7.211 ties it to a fighter's DRONE rail count,
and PL-D and PL-K are plasma rails. The Gorn G-18 carries two PL-D and is likewise zero.
NAMES came from the owner, 2026-10-23, and are NOT in the Master Fighter Chart — it
carries type codes only. They were entered as bare codes first rather than invented, and
the owner supplied the real ones. The pattern they follow is worth knowing before adding
the M-variants: an F prefix is the later fast type (SF -> FSF), and a Type-D or Type-K
suffix names the plasma rail it carries (FSF -> FDF is four PL-D, FTF -> FTK is PL-K).
